metric_note: MIA advantage = TPR - FPR at threshold. NOT the same as AUC. Random baseline is 0.10 (not 0.0) due to class imbalance in synthetic data.
attack_method: YeomMIA (loss threshold, Yeom et al. IEEE CSF 2018)
honest_scope_note: These results measure implementation correctness on synthetic data. They do not measure privacy leakage of any real model or dataset.
